personalities.name: 🥂 You’re a Fuzzy Ski Bunny
personalities.description: You bring the sparkle. You’re all about fun, laughter and making memories with friends. Whether you’re celebrating on a sunny terrace or dancing in ski boots, your energy is contagious. Your cocktail: Lingonberry purée. Aperol. Lemon juice. Sparkling wine. Garnished with orange twist.

personalities.name: 🍸 You’re an Alpine Affair
personalities.description: You love adventure—with style. You appreciate fresh mountain air, beautiful views and experiences that feel just a little elevated. Curious, confident and effortlessly cool—that’s your Austrian Lebensgefühl. Your cocktail: Gin. Elderflower liqueur. Lemon juice. Tonic water. Garnish with lemon wheel.

personalities.name: 🥃 You’re a Last Ru(n)m
personalities.description: You live for the final run — the one with real stakes, real nerve, and a finish worth toasting. Your Lebensgefühl is rich, bold, and built to be remembered. Your cocktail: Rum. Apple cider. Toasted cinnamon Demerara syrup. Lemon juice. Garnish with cinnamon stick.

answers.content: Fresh corduroy from first lift to last run
A mix of skiing, cozy huts and great company
Long lunches, mountain views and taking it all in
